subject: Urgent: AltGen renewal — continuity package & concession recommendation
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@altgen.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Liu <michael@altgen.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal timing + ask for continuity package

Grace —

Thanks for the call earlier. As we discussed, AltGen is running a hard procurement window this quarter and our board wants to see a committed roadmap for cost stability. We like Redwood's runtime performance, but their CFO is flagging the upcoming 22% list increase and wants options that avoid a painful budget spike.

Two asks from finance:
- A 12-month price hold or a phased step-up (we proposed 6/6 months)
- A one-time service credit tied to the two recent incidents (they want $35k back as a show of good faith)

We need a written proposal to take to their procurement committee by next Wednesday (24 Jul). Can you advise what concessions you can offer and whether we can include an SLA add-on during the renewal term?

Attaching our internal procurement worksheet for context.

Thanks,
Elena
Head of Ops — AltGen Analytics

---
Attachment: AltGen-Procurement-Worksheet.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena@altgen.com>, Michael Liu <michael@altgen.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jul 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal timing + ask for continuity package

Ben / Marcus — adding you both so we can align before I send a formal rebuttal to AltGen. Quick summary:
- Customer is a mid-sized analytics ISV; ~120k ARR with 3x expected growth next year.
- Concerned about ~22% list increase; asking for a 12-month price hold or 6/6 phased increase.
- Asking for $35k one-time incident credit and an SLA add-on (4 nines uptime + response SLAs).

I ran a back-of-envelope on impact: a 12-month hold + $35k credit + SLA add-on (engineering on-call buffer) would reduce margin materially but might be defendable as retention cost until product-led expansion kicks in. AltGen is strategic regionally.

Can you each provide: 1) acceptable credit cap, 2) whether we can commit to a 12-month price hold or only phased, and 3) how quickly we can provision a custom SLA bundle (what operational cost does this add)?

I'll draft a one-page continuity proposal for them once we align.

Best,
Grace
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: (sent) AltGen-Procurement-Worksheet.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2029 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal timing + ask for continuity package

Grace —

Thanks for the context. My take: we should prioritize keeping list lift minimal for 12 months if we can pair with a modest revenue commitment. Suggested commercial posture:
- Offer: 10% one-time credit (applied to Yr1 invoice) up to $30k OR a fixed $25k credit (whichever customer prefers).
- Price hold: we can offer a 9-month hold with a single mid-year 6% step (effective at month 10). Full 12-month hold is tougher at their ARR without longer-term commitment.
- SLA add-on: we can craft a standard SLA add-on (SLA-Plus) that includes a 4.9 uptime objective + 4-hr P1 response; ops estimates $8k/mo incremental cost. Implementation: legal and SRE need a 7–10 business day window to sign and provision.

If Marcus signs off on credit ceiling, I can draft the proposed amendment and run legal. I'm fine to offer the $25k fixed credit as a quicker internal approval path.

-Ben
Senior Account Manager — Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2029 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal timing + ask for continuity package

Grace / Ben —

I reviewed the numbers with finance. We can approve a one-time credit up to $28k and the SLA-Plus add-on with the $8k/mo operational overlay, provided AltGen signs a 12-month committed ARR at current units (no headcount-based upsell required). We will not do a 12-month list price hold without a firm contractual renewal term that ensures revenue continuity.

Operational ask: Legal needs an approved amendment draft; SRE needs a confirmed IP allowance for the SLA change. If you can get a written acceptance from the customer on the 12-month committed ARR and confirm acceptance of the SLA-Plus costs, we can move quickly.

Marcus
Director, Renewal Deals — Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@altgen.com>, Michael Liu <michael@altgen.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2029 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal timing + ask for continuity package

Elena —

Thanks for your patience while we reviewed internally. High-level offer we can put on paper for your procurement committee:

1) One-time continuity credit: $25,000 (applied to first renewal invoice) — faster internal approval path.
2) SLA-Plus add-on: optional, $8,000/month, includes 99.9% uptime objective (commercial credit triggers described in the amendment) and 4-hr P1 response. SRE estimates 7–10 business days to provision after contract signature.
3) Price cadence: we can commit to a 9-month price hold followed by a single 6% step for the remainder of the first renewal year (effective month 10). If AltGen is prepared to sign a 12-month committed ARR at current units today, Marcus has approved the $28k credit ceiling instead of the $25k.

Action items for procurement committee meeting:
- Confirm whether AltGen prefers the $25k fixed credit OR to request approval for the $28k ceiling tied to a signed 12-month commitment.
- Confirm whether you want SLA-Plus as part of the renewal (adds $8k/mo).
- Sign the amended MSA; legal will prepare the amendment (we will share a draft within 48 hours once you confirm the credit option).

If you can confirm by COB Monday (22 Jul) we will run legal and SRE immediately so you have a clean proposal for the 24 Jul procurement review.

Best,
Grace
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: Proposed-Continuity-PO-2029-07-18.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Elena Park <elena@altgen.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Liu <michael@altgen.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2029 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal timing + ask for continuity package

Grace —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and clarity. AltGen will take the $25k fixed credit and add the SLA-Plus for the first 6 months (we'll revisit operational need thereafter). Procurement will sign the amendment pending legal review — we will confirm formal language and sign by Monday COB.

Two quick clarifications before we execute:
1) Can you confirm the credit is applied to the first renewal invoice and not netted against future usage?
2) Will SRE onboard within the 7–10 business day window after signature (we're sensitive to backlog across Q3)?

Thanks,
Elena
Head of Ops — AltGen Analytics
